CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fulfillment_private.guard_offer()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$begin
 if new.state='pending'and not fulfillment_private.unblocked(new.order_id)then raise exception 'customer_confirmation_required';end if;return new;end $function$
